html:
The Mutumui were an Aboriginal Australian people of the eastern Cape York Peninsula in north Queensland, near Princess Charlotte Bay. The map shows them from 1600 to 1800.

Almost nothing is recorded of them beyond their name and territory. Neighbours on the map include the Lama Lama, the Guugu Yimithirr and the Kokowarra. The Palmer River gold rush of the 1870s, just inland, brought miners, police and cattlemen into the region and hit its peoples hard. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
